jobs.occupation: Working Student Procurement Strategy (d/f/m) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Business Governance department, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

Working Student Procurement Strategy (d/f/m) – CAPEX management support and Governance & Process Optimization

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Project Manager (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Business Governance department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.08.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Finkenwerder

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.
- Strategic Impact: You don’t just administrative tasks; you help shape the way we manage investments.
- High-Level Exposure: Gain insights into global investment projects and strategic decision-making within a leading company.
- Professional Growth: Close collaboration with experienced procurement managers and cross-functional teams.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- End-to-End Coordination: Act as a central hub for CAPEX requests. Oversee the meeting landscape and ensure clarity on "who does what" to drive projects from initial request to final approval.
- Stakeholder Alignment: Align and collaborate closely with CAPEX managers, strategic buyers, and engineering to ensure the standardized CAPEX Template is completed accurately and on time.
- Process Optimization & Governance: Support the streamlining of internal procurement processes and contribute to the design of a more efficient CAPEX governance.
- Decision Support: Support the preparation and presentation of CAPEX requests in Multi-Functional Team (MFT) or decision-making forums to secure necessary funding.
- Active Communication & Follow-up: Proactively follow up on open actions. If a request is rejected or budget is cut, you ensure the information is communicated back to the project leads and budgets are adjusted accordingly in the systems.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Academic Background: Enrolled fulltime student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field.
- Mindset: Strong interest in strategic procurement and investment processes (CAPEX), with a passion for building lean and efficient structures.
- Analytical Skills: Good knowledge of Google Workspace(especially sheets and presentation); you should be comfortable reconciling financial data (Actuals) and creating clear management summaries.
- Strong data affinity/interest in developing structured databases, or digitalizing workflows.
- Communication: Strong communication skills and team spirit. You are comfortable acting as a bridge between technical engineering teams and financial controllers.
- Working Style: Highly structured, reliable, and "End-to-End" oriented—you don't just see the task, but the entire process flow.
- Languages: Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

As a PMO Professional (f/m/d) in Offshore Automation, you support effective project execution through structured planning, governance, reporting, and documentation across complex project lifecycles. Working closely with Project and Sub‑Project Managers, you ensure transparency, rigorous schedule control, effective reviews, and consistent tracking of actions, risks, and decisions.
You operate in a highly technical environment delivering customer‑specific offshore automation solutions, providing reliable coordination and project control so delivery teams can focus on execution. Your role includes milestone tracking, facilitation of project reviews, cross‑functional coordination, and continuous improvement of templates, processes, and project standards.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Support of Project Managers in the preparation, maintenance, and governance of integrated project schedules, including baselines, progress tracking, and milestone control
* Planning, preparation, and coordination of structured project review meetings to ensure transparency and effective decision‑making
* Documentation of meetings and maintenance of action, risk, and issue trackers with active follow‑up to ensure timely closure
* Support of project controlling and monitoring through consolidation of schedule status, KPIs, milestones, and commitments in line with PMO frameworks
* Tracking of procurement schedules, supplier milestones, and material delivery timelines in close coordination with project and procurement teams
* Contribution to the development, standardization, and continuous improvement of PMO processes, templates, and guidelines

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Economics or a technical apprenticeship with working experience
* First experience in PMO, project planning / scheduling, or project controls within EPC or infrastructure projects
* Knowledge in MS Project and Primavera P6 are preferred 
* Strong organizational, documentation, and follow‑up capabilities
* High team orientation, adaptability, and openness to multicultural collaboration. Self‑motivated, independent, and quality‑oriented working style with a drive for continuous improvement
* Excellent English skills, willingness to travel domestically and internationally; German language skills considered a plus

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

A dedicated mentor will support you every step of the way, giving you the chance to explore different roles, engage in immersive experiences, and build a strong network with peers and industry leaders.

As part of our offshore automation team working on grid connection projects, you’ll be an integral part of the project management organization and get to know all key stakeholders. You’ll have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to real-world projects and gain hands-on experience in project planning, execution, and monitoring, while simultaneously contributing to our mission of sustainable development. 

How You’ll Make an Impact

As part of our Graduate Program, you are on the Siemens Energy team. You’ll share our purpose in energizing society by supporting customers with transitioning to a more sustainable world and work on real global issues, creating solutions that directly make an impact.
* Work as part of the project team and support coordination with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, manufacturers, suppliers, and contractors

What You Bring

* Relevant experience through internships and/or working student roles is essential; additional permanent work experience of up to 36 months is welcome

* Minimum of 3 months of international experience gained through studying or working
* Excellent English skills to engage in a multicultural environment, with flexibility and willingness for international travel.

Grid Technologies

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by at least 130 nationalities. A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Risk Manager, you start the day reviewing the latest project risk dashboards and speaking with project managers to anticipate potential challenges before they arise. You facilitate a risk and opportunity workshop for a high-impact energy project, translating insights into concrete actions integrated into schedules and budgets. Throughout the day, you collaborate across engineering, commercial, and portfolio teams to ensure risks are transparently communicated and response strategies are executed. Your work directly improves project profitability, strengthens resilience, and advances Siemens Energy’s mission to deliver sustainable, reliable energy solutions. You’ll be part of an open, solution-focused team culture that values proactive thinking, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Early and comprehensive identification of project risks and opportunities throughout the entire lifecycle, from tendering to completion
* Embedding of risk management into daily project governance processes, ensuring alignment of actions, responsibilities, and timelines
* Translation of risk insights into clear, owned response strategies and their integration into project schedules, budgets, and forecasts
* Consolidation of individual project risks at portfolio level to enable the detection of broader trends and systemic exposures for decision makers
* Maintenance of transparent, fact-based risk communication to management and stakeholders to ensure trust and clarity
* Development of organizational capability through workshops, coaching, and lessons-learned processes to increase overall risk maturity

What You Bring

* University degree in Industrial Engineering or a comparable field
* Proven experience in project and portfolio risk management, ideally within complex, large‑scale energy or infrastructure environments
* Strong capability in identifying, assessing, and managing risks and opportunities with a proactive, value‑driven mindset
* Excellent communication skills enabling clear conveyance of risk insights and effective influence across all stakeholder levels
* Competence in integrating risk management into schedules, budgets, and governance routines, with strong analytical ability to recognize patterns and trends at portfolio level to support informed decision‑making
* A collaborative working approach and willingness to contribute to capability building within diverse, cross-functional teams as well as fluent English skills; German language skills are an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: VIE - Acoustic Engineer for Interior Noise (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Interior Noise Engineering Team, Airbus is looking for a

VIE Acoustic Engineer for Interior Noise (d/f/m)

You are a highly motivated graduate and want to get to know the work of an acoustic engineer?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Interior Noise Engineering Team as a Volunteer for International Experience.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.07.2026
- Duration: 12 months with possible extension to 24 months

Definition VIE

The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) program is an international program sponsored by the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Employment, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. We are looking for highly motivated graduates aged 18 to 28 years, who are citizens of the European Union (all E.U. nationals, plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein). Candidates meeting these criteria and interested in a VIE, please register before your 28th birthday on the website www.civiweb.com (http://www.civiweb.com) . For graduates who would be interested in a career with Airbus, this could be the start of a rewarding future in a dynamic and forward-thinking sector.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support technical projects in the RnT and series programme's perimeter
- Build simulation models and validate them by measurement
- Develop passive and active noise treatments for existing and future aircrafts
- Propose and assess low-noise designs and technologies
- Support trades/multidisciplinary optimizations at aircraft level
- Your role will involve some limited business travel in Europe and as such you must be able to travel, accordingly

Desired skills and qualifications

- You have a Master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Acoustics or equivalent
- You have knowledge in the vibro-acoustic perimeter
- You have programming experience with numerical methods, (e.g. Python, Simulink / Matlab)
- You feel comfortable to take on own projects and include stakeholders
- You demonstrate a positive and collaborative mindset and a passion for creating a good team spirit
- Your open-minded attitude and proactive personality helps you to drive change, solve problems and convince others
- You are able to easily negotiate in English; an advanced level in German is a plus

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, letters of reference.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
IT Inhouse Consultant – SAP S/4

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

As IT Inhouse Consultant – SAP S/4 Finance Consolidation & Reporting (m/f/diverse), you will be responsible for requirements recording, concept development and solution implementation of the group reporting system and technical requirements.

Your tasks will also include the following activities:

- Analyze business requirements and develop concepts for group reporting in close collaboration with the relevant departments
- Management of the implementation of these concepts, ensuring alignment with business requirements and technical feasibility
- Planning and execution of the transformation to SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting
- Drive innovation and use of new technologies in the SAP Finance area
- Integration of new reporting applications into the existing system landscape
- Continuous evaluation and optimization of existing processes and applications
- Individual user support and knowledge transfer
- Support and monitor of the reporting cycles, including administrative tasks
- Leading and coordinating internal and external project team members

Qualifications

The ideal candidate (m/f/diverse) will possess the following qualifications:

- Academic degree in Information Technology, or a comparable qualification
- Deep expertise in SAP SEM-BCS and SAP BW
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting and SAP Central Finance
- Knowledge of SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud, and SAP Query Design
- Strong business understanding of group accounting and consolidation processes
- Excellent IT knowledge of process workflows, database architectures and system integration
- Experience in project leadership and project management
- Fluency in German and English, both spoken and written
- Strong communication skills as well as competence in conflict management

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.
